result.summary: Found 1 major visual/content issue: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. Excluding intended horizontal-scroll clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff, the rest of the page layout appears intact.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant twice side-by-side: two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, '15-25 min' time, and '€0.90 delivery' price, suggesting a duplication/deduplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurants by ID in the feed/API response before rendering. If these are genuinely two different locations, add a distinguishing label such as street name, neighbourhood, or distance to each card.
